hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *'git push'*|*'git merge'*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git push/merge blocked by project policy — owner runs these manually"}}'; exit 0;; esac; case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) b=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$b" in main|master|feat/*) printf '%s' "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"git commit blocked on protected branch $b — needs owner approval\"}}";; esac;; esac
